its... fine. fun game to waste some time on. 

the guns and abilities are very fun to use. everything else... eh.

maps are so incredibly boring. from aesthetic choices to layout, they are very drab and detract from the experience. and theres barely any variety in objectives in tasks: get somewhere and automatically start a wave or get somewhere and press a button to start a wave. the most interesting part is collecting synth batteries by killing synth wardens and bringing them to an objective.

the progression is... ok, but it ends far too soon. i think the main reason for this is that theres no real aftermath. progression stems from leveling up guns and classes or collecting attachments and guns. but after you level up your class and guns completely, theres nothing else. no prestiges or bonuses. no alternate challenges or paths to take. and you gain most of the unlockables rather quickly, leaving you to grind for credits for the rest exclusive to the store.

buy on sale.
pretty boring nothing really new kinda dead game sad

[h1]Aliens Fireteam Elite[/h1] is a great Game in the Alien-Universe (franchise) like Dead Space 3 Co-op (Teambased Shooter to play with Friends) or (2 bots named Alpha and Beta) in 3rd view point, When sticking to the wall we can see how amazing the game could be in first person but... sometime we really need to use 'dash' to evade hits, I not sure how that would work if the game was on fps only, lol ;p

There good Memories of Nostalgia from Aliens Movies such as: Alien, Aliens, Alien 3, Alien Resurrection and also the Pathogens from The Pre- Prometheus and Alien: Covenant.

[b]Great for aliens fans,[/b] every campaign is like different movie, as you got this game just find friends.
You need finish all campaigns to Unlock 'Quickplay' and 'New Game Modes' will be open.
The Special Game Modes are: Horde, Point Defense, Restock Turrets and Hardcore mode.
Good luck, Have fun marines!

[b]Pros:[/b]
Great Graphics, Lots of 'Weapons Colors' and 'Decals', Also 'Weapons Attachments' and included 'Character Customization' can play as Male or Female with different voice indeed, we have Very Cool 'Emotes' to show for friends as well.

7 Classes to Select and use their own special 'Perks' and 'Abilities':
Gunner, Demolisher, Technician, Doc, Phalanx, Lancer and (Recon) <- Locked after campaigns finish.

We got "Crossplay" in season 4 update to play with marines at Playstation, Xbox and Epic games ;P

There is 30+ weapons in the game with kinds of Heavy, Rifles, CQC and Handgun, they are deadly but the aliens as well ;D

There is a 'Hidden Cache' loot in every mission to collect a nice additional bonus for mission complition, if lose the mission this bonus stay with us, The 'Hidden Cache' making unique sound if not aware of it's spot listen to the surrounding not to the aliens xD

Also There 5 Difficulties, We start with Casual, Standard and Intense.. after finishing all campaigns two other difficulties will Unlock those are: (Extreame) and (Insane).

[b]Pro Tips:[/b]
[b]1)[/b] Press "Middle Mouse" button to 'Ping' (heads up) stuff to your Fellow Fireteam.
[b]2)[/b] Maximum amount of credits is 50,000 and 10,000 scrips, after reaching to the max you'll not own more of them, USE them at the Armory (in-game store) Marines :-)
[b]3)[/b] Medic Bag adds 1,251 amount of health per player.

[b] Cons:[/b]
Not works on Windows 7, sadly No Chat to message marines and No Voice Chat, Have supprising crashes and Sometimes people get "Lost Connection to Host" at online match, Also No matchmaking browser, hard to find people in queues... Just add People to your friendlist and use disscord, enjoy speak and chat with them while playing.

Terminal Containment is here! Make it through wave 10 on Intense, Extreme, or Insane and you’ll unlock some unique rewards.


Five (4) New Weapon Colors

(Rewards for Extreme+ difficulties)

Three (2) New Emotes

(Rewards for Intense+ difficulties)
 
Five (4) New Weapon Decals

(Rewards for Insane difficulty)
Like L4D2, this game is just great and very addictive for hours, especially for horde shooters lover.

There are so many reasons to love this game, but the difficulty curve is definitely off, as others have commented. I'd prefer MORE aliens over the bullet sponge approach. The customization options are vast, and some are really unique. The level modifiers are also a nice touch, although some are super goofy (but make perfect sense). Overall, this is a must have.
